parsed.why: No facility ban on the books, city ordinances and a GI hate-crime law operate; the 2026 document-marker ban is largely resident-facing, minor-care ban only. Sits modestly above the hostile national baseline.

Enforced birth-sex facility ban covering public buildings/airports with criminal trespass, one documented arrest, licence-marker denial and adult care barriers; two travel advisories issued. Heavy universal exposure above the national layer.

2026 birth-sex facility law with criminal penalties plus bounty suits by any private person, licence invalidation actively enforced; risk assessment moved it to Do Not Travel. Universal exposure with privatised enforcement, worst of the five.

Hostile statutes enacted but repeatedly enjoined by state courts applying equal protection; facilities law and care ban not in force, marker changes blocked but litigated. Operating judicial relief lifts it above the national mean.

Most-Protective tier: gender-identity non-discrimination, hate-crime coverage, care shield law, facility use unrestricted, identity-congruent custody. Local layer mitigates strongly though national document/screening exposure persists.
